svg.title: Papers-HQ pipeline: empirical and macro tracks

text.tspan: Papers-HQ pipeline — one orchestrator, two paper types
Stops the pipeline if any HARD equilibrium test fails
Loops: reject all → Stage 2 · weak idea or rejected design → Stage 2.5 · R&R between 5 and 6 (max 3 rounds)
Models: opus → claude-opus-5-5 (verdicts, referees, macro, Lean) · sonnet → claude-sonnet-5-5 (default) · haiku → claude-haiku-4-5
